comparison.objective: Lower and seat a platform simultaneously on cone, groove, and flat kinematic datums; candidate registers switch mounts.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual six-degree-of-freedom platform control and three-point contact seating versus one-dimensional mounted sliding and screwdriver fastening.
comparison.success_condition: All three datum contacts must meet 0.20 mm clearance with pose errors below 3 mm/3° and release held 1 second; candidate requires two secured proximity states.
comparison.reason: Multi-datum rigid seating is a different tested alignment ability and contains no adjustable mount or fastening-under-registration.
